verdict.rationale: Viam offers 'test panels' and browser-based controls to 'debug without deploying code' and mentions 'canary testing and rollbacks for safe versioning', which suggest some isolated testing capability, but there is no explicit sandbox environment or data isolation from production described. missing for 10: dedicated sandbox/staging environment concept, explicit guarantee that test data doesn't touch production datasets, and any first-party or community confirmation of production/sandbox separation.
